items.information: La Savoie a sa propre identité, peu importe à quel royaume ou pays elle est rattachée, il semble bon de lui dédier un petit rassemblement annuel autour du cube et de la tradition locale. Savoie has its own identity, no matter what kingdom or country it's officially part of, it seems good to dedicate a small annual gathering around cubing and some local traditions.
